title: Pretty happy with the art style ngl...
author: Im_Peppermint_Butler
selftext:
This is my first time trying to make a game. 

As someone who took art classes from elementary through high school(and spent many, MANY hours honing that craft), I am so grateful for this. The amount of different backgrounds, items, characters, and expressions, would've literally taken me HUNDREDS of hours. Not even touching the programming. Not even touching the animations. 

I have so many ideas I can't wait to try knowing that the models are so artistically and mechanically steerable. I have been following this space since before chatgpt and this is the first time where I really feel it's super useful for ambitious projects.

comments.author: AdStreet4350
comments.body: Pretty good overall, but the UI feels a bit too crowded. I’d reduce the number of menus and give everything a bit more breathing The character is really cute !

replies.body: Thanks! I definitely timed the screenshot at the moment with the most things happening on screen. Im a big fan of dopamine overload type of games and was trying to recreate that. Ill dial it back if I get that same feedback from playtesters though!
